description: React component for a Kanban board column, including inline editing, card filtering, and modal handling for delete confirmation.

methods.name: validateNewTitle(str)
methods.description: Validates the new title for the column, ensuring it is not empty and different from the current title.

methods.name: triggerTitleEdit
methods.description: Activates inline editing mode for the column title.

methods.name: saveEditTitle
methods.description: Saves the new column title after validation and updates the backend.

methods.name: handleTitleInputKey
methods.description: Handles keyboard events in the title input, including Enter to save and Escape to cancel.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Sets the modal state to trigger delete confirmation dialog.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Confirms and executes deletion of the column, showing toast notifications.

methods.name: Column({ column, index, isDragging, isOver, filteredCards, isCompact })

ctags.signature: ({ column, index, isDragging, isOver, filteredCards, isCompact })
